title: Microsoft Purview: network DLP policies for all websites through Entra Internet Access
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the planned all-websites scope from today's documented network DLP controls, licensing and inspection limits. The enforcement-setting path needs a minor expansion to include the cloud-app selection that precedes it.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans all-websites scoping for network data security DLP policies integrated with Entra GSA Internet Access.
claims.quote: admins can scope their network data security data loss prevention policies, integrated with Entra GSA Internet Access, to apply to all websites

claims.claim: Administrators will also be able to scope the policies to all websites except specific cloud apps.
claims.quote: or all websites except specific cloud apps

claims.claim: Traffic is allowed when Purview inspection cannot complete, such as because of an oversized payload or internal error.
claims.quote: In scenarios where Purview inspection is unable to complete, such as a payload that is too large to inspect, or an internal error, the traffic is allowed (fail-open).

claims.claim: Learn says to allow up to 24 hours for policy distribution and the first data after configuring the integration.
claims.quote: After you configure the integration between Microsoft Purview and your network security solution, allow up to 24 hours for your policies to be distributed to the network security solution and for the first data to show up.

claims.quote: In activity explorer, you can filter events with enforcement plane set to network. This filter shows you activities that network data security policies generate.

claims.quote: Transactions that have skipped inspection can be identified in Traffic logs using PurviewStatus field.

claims.claim: The GSA network data security entitlement is per-user.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 E7 per-seat licenses; Purview E5 (or equivalent) per-seat licenses and Entra Internet Access (or equivalent) licenses

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 E7 per-seat licences are one documented GSA network data security licence route.
claims.quote: Network data security with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access requires one of the following license combinations: - Microsoft 365 E7 per-seat licenses

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The other route is Purview E5 or equivalent per-seat licences plus Entra Internet Access or equivalent licences.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Internet Access users also need Entra ID P1 or P2.
claims.quote: To use Microsoft Entra Private Access and Microsoft Entra Internet Access, users need a Microsoft Entra ID P1 or Microsoft Entra ID P2 license.

claims.claim: Pay-as-you-go setup is not required for the GSA integration.
claims.quote: Pay-as-you-go is not required to be set up for integration with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access.

claims.claim: Pay-as-you-go setup is required for non-Microsoft SASE and secure browser integrations.
claims.quote: You must configure pay-as-you-go for your Microsoft 365 tenant to use Purview network data security with non-Microsoft SASE and secure browser solutions.

claims.claim: The Purview service description describes network DLP generally as pay-as-you-go without giving the GSA exception.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) for cloud apps accessed via the network ... These features are pay-as-you-go capabilities.

claims.claim: The content-policy page lists a valid Entra Internet Access licence.
claims.quote: A valid Microsoft Entra Internet Access license.

claims.claim: The content-policy page requires a valid Purview licence for Scan with Purview.
claims.quote: A valid Microsoft Purview license, required for Scan with Purview inspection.

claims.quote: If you don't see Data loss prevention in Microsoft Purview ... You need a role such as DLP Compliance Management or Information Protection Admin, and a Microsoft 365 E5/A5 subscription or a Microsoft Purview DLP add-on.

claims.claim: A licence rule specific to the all-websites scope is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview network DLP all websites scope price meter licence GSA; read network data security overview, Purview service description, Entra licensing overview and content-policy prerequisites. General integration licences are stated; no scope-specific rule is stated.

claims.claim: The content-policy page permits an Entra ID joined or hybrid joined device for the GSA client.
claims.quote: The Global Secure Access client requires a device (or virtual machine) that is either Microsoft Entra ID joined or Microsoft Entra ID Hybrid joined.

claims.claim: Initial configuration requires enabling the Internet Access traffic forwarding profile.
claims.quote: Enable the Internet Access traffic forwarding profile and ensure correct user assignments.

claims.claim: The content-policy setup calls for the GSA client on Windows or macOS and traffic routed through GSA.
claims.quote: Install the Global Secure Access client on Windows or macOS. ... Before you continue, test and ensure your client's internet traffic is routed through Global Secure Access.

claims.claim: The printed Purview portal path reaches the adaptive cloud-app selection for a network DLP policy.
claims.quote: Select Custom from the Categories list and then select Custom policy from the Regulations list. ... Select + Add cloud apps. Select the Adaptive app scopes tab, then choose All unmanaged AI apps

claims.claim: No documented automation parameter chooses the cloud-app scope of a network DLP policy.
claims.quote: Searched: New Set DlpCompliancePolicy network cloud apps scope parameter; network DlpCompliancePolicy Locations cloud apps. Opened and searched New/Set-DlpCompliancePolicy references; Locations documents Copilot, and ThirdPartyAppDlpLocation documents connected apps, not network scopes.

claims.claim: The printed Purview path reaches Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers but omits the intervening cloud-app selection.
claims.quote: Select + Add cloud apps. Select the Adaptive app scopes tab, then choose All unmanaged AI apps ... On the Choose where to enforce the policy page, ensure Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers is On
claims.fix: Replace controls[1].ui.path and its rendered table path with 'Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Inline web traffic > Categories > Custom > Regulations > Custom policy > + Add cloud apps > Adaptive app scopes > app scope > Choose where to enforce the policy > Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers'. Set its docs to https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/global-secure-access/how-to-network-content-filtering, whose DLP steps document this route without the walkthrough's scenario-specific user inclusions.

claims.claim: Security & Compliance PowerShell supports New-DlpCompliancePolicy -EnforcementPlanes @("Network") to create a DLP policy with that enforcement layer.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell. ... The EnforcementPlanes parameter defines the layer where policy actions are run. ... -EnforcementPlanes @("<Value>"). Valid values are: ... Network

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference lists Network without a value-specific description.
claims.quote: Searched: EnforcementPlanes and Network in the opened New-DlpCompliancePolicy reference. Its valid-values list gives Browser and Application descriptions but only '- Network' for this value.

claims.claim: The printed Entra admin center path reaches a new content-policy rule's Action > Scan with Purview setting.
claims.quote: Browse to Global Secure Access > Secure > Content policies. ... Select + Create Policy. ... On the Basics tab ... On the Rules tab: Add a new rule. ... Action menu ... select Scan with Purview.

claims.claim: No documented API operation sets the content-policy Scan with Purview action; its cited page provides portal steps.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Graph networkAccess contentFilteringPolicies Scan with Purview content policy create action; networkAccess contentPolicy purview Graph API. Opened content-policy steps, Graph filteringPolicy and filteringRule references; no Scan with Purview setter is documented.

claims.claim: Conditional Access changes require Conditional Access Administrator.
claims.quote: A Conditional Access Administrator role to configure Conditional Access policies.

claims.claim: The Purview rule's actions should match the content types and activities selected in the GSA content policy.
claims.quote: The actions you select in the Purview DLP rule should match the content types and activities you selected in the Global Secure Access content policy.
